newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ayer Molek Rubber announces restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Ayer Molek Rubber announces restructuring.

text.p: Rubber and oil palm producer Ayer Molek Rubber Co Bhd said it is proposing a rescue and restructuring plan that will enable it to return to profitability.

The programme includes a proposed bonus issue of 64.80 million new shares on the basis of 36-for-one; and a proposed sale of provisional rights-to-allotment of 95.40 million Ayer Molek shares by various vendors on the basis of 53-for-one at 2.90 ringgit a share, Ayer Molek said in a statement.
The company is also proposing a special issue of 93.40 million new Ayer Molek shares at 2.00 per new share to Indah Lestari Sdn Bhd, an existing large shareholder of Ayer Molek.
The special issue would enable Ayer Molek to raise total cash proceeds of about 186.80 million ringgit, it said.
Use of the funds would be for repayment of debt, working capital and other purposes.
Ayer Molek said it would revalue certain freehold landed properties in the central state of Melaka and southern Johor state.

Ayer Molek has incurred losses for the past three financial years. For the year ended December 31, 1996, it registered a pre-tax loss of 3.2 million ringgit. "The proposals would enable the group to return to profitability immediately upon completion," the statement said.
Ayer Molek's stock has been suspended for a news announcement. Its shares last traded on June 5 at 119.00 ringgit.
